title: Chase says ‘software bug’ could be causing disruptions at major U.S. banks
html:
Customers of Chase, Bank of America and other U.S. banks have reported service outages; so have customers of the money-transfer service Zelle.

Customers of major U.S. banks and peer-to-peer payment service Zelle have reported service outages on Monday, according to the website Downdetector.

Chase JPM, Bank of America BAC, U.S. Bank USB, Wells Fargo WFC, Zelle and Capital One COF were the top financial institutions with reported outages as of 4:30 p.m. Monday, according to Downdetector.
summary: Some customers are saying they can’t access their accounts or their unable to withdraw funds.
